parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The direction of the traffic flow from the perspective of the APMLD. {{enum}}

parameters.name: TID
parameters.description: The traffic identifier (TID) for this mapping.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: The BSSID of the preferred link (affiliated AP) to use for traffic with matching direction and TID values.

parameters.name: LinkID
parameters.description: {{list}} The Link ID of the preferred link (affiliated AP) to use for traffic with matching direction and TID values.

object.description: Table of Traffic Identifier (TID) to Link Mappings of the Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable access point (AP). Each table entry describes the mapping between a particular TID and direction and preferred link. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: TID-to-Link Mapping Policy TLV.
